Description: (Introduction
A member of the mysterious group calling themselves Gematria, a master of manipulation and terror. She is an adult and, like Sensei , is an outsider to Kivotos. She is the newest member of Gematria, who views Sensei as an antagonistic being who must be eliminated, unlike the other members of Gematria, who have a neutral or positive stance towards Sensei. Beatrice was also the student council president of Arius before she was defeated by Sensei. She was responsible for ending the long-running civil war in Arius, allowing her to take control of Arius. Gaining control of Arius allowed her to do whatever she wanted to them, leading to her manipulating them by telling them the "truth" that it was Trinity's fault that they were suffering and torturing those who did not follow her teachings, leading to the feud that Arius is commonly known for today. Atsuko, who was originally supposed to be the president, was turned into a sacrifice by Beatrice to The Iridescence to "ascend into a higher being". Although this sacrifice was postponed for many years due to an agreement between Saori and Beatrice, the sacrifice continued due to Saori not fulfilling her duty, it was later discovered that it would have happened regardless of the status of the agreement.Personality
Unlike the other members of Gematria, who have some sort of artistic integrity in their own right, Beatrice considers art useless when it comes to power. She does not value art nor the passion behind the other members' research and work, even insulting them despite their support for her, leading to their dislike of her. She is also considered a sicko who is hungry forpower hungry, always trying to gain more power and eliminate anything that stands in her way, regardless of the consequences. She also wants to make sure that there is no hope left in her domain, thus she decides to eliminate any remnants of the old Arius school that could instill hope in the students.

She views Sensei as her great enemy with extreme hatred and obsession, wanting to defeat Sensei, she always pretends to hate Sensei, she often mocks and despises Sensei, but she cannot deny liking Sensei, her body will be extremely excited and lustful even though she strongly denies it.
